messages:
Aisha: Hey folks — quick thought: small "Sunset Sampler" this Thursday? Start at the food stalls by 6:15pm then head up to the courtyard roof for acoustic sets. Low-key, BYO blanket optional. :sunset: :taco:
Ben: Love the name. 6:15 works for me.
Diego: I can bring a guitar if anyone wants a few acoustic songs.
Cara: Im in. Any chance of a dessert truck? :ice_cream:
Aisha: Theres usually a crepe cart around the corner. I can text them to check hours.
Ben: Heads up re: rooftop capacity? ops-bot: Reminder: gatherings >10 require Facilities approval. Submit form: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
ops-bot: Facilities note: courtyard rooftop max 20. For >12, please file FR. Link: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Aisha: Good to know — Ill submit a quick request now and set a 20-person soft RSVP cap.
Diego: If rooftop fills, courtyard lawn works too.
Cara: Quick poll: "Acoustic open-mic" / "Chill playlist" / "Silent munch" — react with :guitar:, :notes:, :zipper_mouth_face:
Ben: :guitar: from me. small open-mic sounds fun.
Aisha: :notes: Id rather keep it super chill.
Diego: :guitar: would be fun to play a couple tunes.
Cara: :zipper_mouth_face: if people want to eat then keep quiet.
Aisha: Also, heads-up for folks with allergies: there will be a nut-free signage at the dessert stand but double-check with vendors.
Ben: I can collect a small cash pool for tips and busking jar if Diego performs.
Diego: Ha, Ill take a tip jar but no expectations.
ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "Sunset Sampler  Food + Acoustic" on company calendar for 2024-07-11 18:15. Facilities request submitted (ID: FR-5150).
Aisha: Thanks ops-bot. Volunteers: I can coordinate vendor confirmations; Ben can handle tips; Cara handles napkins/blankets?
Cara: Yep, Ill bring a couple of blankets and a small bluetooth speaker.
Ben: Putting a soft RSVP in the calendar now. If we hit 20, Ill mark a waiting list and we do a quick rotation.
Aisha: Plan: Thursday meet 6:10pm in lobby, stroll to stalls, grab a bite, rooftop for first 20, lawn fallback. Keep it casual. See you there! :raised_hands:
